summary: The web member profile popover now allows the identity text column to shrink within the fixed avatar/popover width, clamps long display names to two lines and truncates long logins with an ellipsis, matching Flutter behavior.

checks.name: Test-first long identity regression
checks.observation: The new regression initially failed because the identity text column had no min-width constraint and the login had no overflow treatment. It now confirms a shrinkable identity column, two-line display-name clamp and single-line ellipsis for the login.

checks.name: TypeScript check and production frontend build
checks.observation: vue-tsc and Vite production build pass. Vite reports the existing LiveKit chunk-size advisory (>500 kB).

remaining: The long login and display-name layout is covered by CSS regression assertions; manual screenshot comparison at responsive breakpoints remains part of the broader open visual QA.
